hints.text: 'Problematic' is our anagram indicator — it tells us to mix up some neighbouring letters.
Our fodder is 'No stamp' — we'll use these letters as the indicator directs.

The definition of this clue is kind of the whole surface. You could say that the definition is just 'for him', but it borrows the context of the whole surface - for whom would 'no stamp' be problematic? This technique is called a partial &lit - where the whole clue is the definition, but only part of the clue is the wordplay.
